subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian cities is famous for its oranges?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagpur**

 
 
• Nagpur, often known as the **city of oranges**, is very famous for its oranges.
 
• It is in the state of **Maharashtra, India**.
 
• After Mumbai and Pune, it is the **third-largest city **in Maharashtra.
 
• It serves as Maharashtra's **wintertime capital**.
 
• The **Tiger Capital of India** and the **Tiger Gateway of India** are other names for Nagpur.
